decisions.statement: A value under a property holding a boolean is spelled bare.
A value under a property holding a number is spelled bare.
A value under any other property is spelled as JSON spells it.
A value the kind stated does not hold is spelled as nothing.
A kind stated as nothing spells the value as JSON spells it.
Nothing here reads a body or an index.
Nothing here says which key the value is written under.

definition: the literal a page body spells for one value handed in as text under the kind its property holds
